name: Plex
notes: Warm charcoal with two gold beams leaning off the top-right edge, echoing the existing Plex treatment. Gold x is the only bright colour in the card.

name: YouTube
notes: Red-black base with a playback progress bar along the bottom edge: track and filled red. The play badge carries the red accent in the centre.

name: YouTube TV
notes: Cool slate-navy with diagonal slashes off the top-left corner, so it reads as a different family from red YouTube. Regular weight, no play badge, coral TV.

name: Netflix
notes: Near-black with a red corner wedge and a single diagonal ribbon at the bottom-right. Abstract sweep, no N shape.

name: Prime Video
notes: Deep navy with a blue crescent sweeping up from the bottom-left corner. Lighter regular-weight lowercase wordmark. The arc is generic, not the smile.

name: Disney+
notes: Deep midnight navy with nested arches hanging from the top edge, like a spotlight dome, and a small bright star-diamond at bottom-right. Regular weight.

name: Hulu
notes: Very dark green base with two vertical stripes at the left edge, a clean nod to the lowercase bold wordmark in the brand green family.

name: HBO Max
notes: Deep indigo base with a two-tone violet prism wedge pointing in from the right edge. The Max accent in lilac carries the Max gradient idea.

name: Peacock TV
notes: Deep teal-black with three tapered feather rays fanning from the bottom-centre in teal, blue and muted gold. Suggests the feather fan without the logo.
